content:
Kotlin turned 15 this year, and we’re celebrating with the 15th episode of Kotlin Heroes! 💜

Kotlin Heroes is a series of online programming contests, where participants solve algorithmic problems using Kotlin. Whether you’re new to the language or an experienced programmer, it’s a chance to practice your Kotlin skills, challenge yourself, and have some fun along the way.

Over the past 14 episodes, Kotlin Heroes has attracted nearly 190,000 registrations across practice rounds and contests. A big thank-you to everyone who’s been part of this journey!

The next contest takes place on December 8, 2026, and the practice round will open on December 1, 2026. Join us for this anniversary edition and get a chance to win an exclusive Kotlin Heroes anniversary T-shirt!

Join Kotlin Heroes: Episode 15

How it works

  • Warm up in the practice round. Get familiar with the contest format, solve training problems, and use available hints and solutions whenever you need help.
  • Compete on December 8. You’ll have 2 hours and 30 minutes to tackle problems ranging from beginner-friendly tasks to challenges for experienced competitive programmers.
  • Win prizes! Top participants will receive cash prizes and exclusive anniversary T-shirts. Plus, everyone who solves at least one problem in the main contest has a chance to win a T-shirt in the raffle.

Why join?

Learning a new programming language is a valuable skill, and one of the best ways to improve is to solve problems yourself.

With AI becoming part of everyday programming, Kotlin Heroes is an opportunity to celebrate human problem-solving, challenge yourself, and discover what you can accomplish with Kotlin!

Prizes

You don’t have to finish at the top of the leaderboard to win something!

  • 🥇 1st place: $512
  • 🥈 2nd place: $256
  • 🥉 3rd place: $128
  • 🎽 Top 50 participants: Exclusive Kotlin Heroes 15th anniversary T-shirts
  • 🎁 50 additional anniversary T-shirts: Raffled among participants who solve at least one problem

Get ready for the contest

  • Watch our Kotlin in Competitive Programming playlist for tips from experienced competitive programmers.
  • Read the Kotlin competitive programming tutorial.
  • Explore previous Kotlin Heroes contest solutions, including Episode 12, Episode 13, and Episode 14.

A note on fair play: Kotlin Heroes is about testing your own problem-solving skills. AI-assisted problem solving is restricted during the main contest, so please review the Codeforces AI usage rules before participating. Let’s keep the competition fair and enjoyable for everyone!

Register for Kotlin Heroes: Episode 15

See you on December 8, and good luck!
